findings.title: Diff snippet can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: In verifySafeHtml the code computes a common prefix `start` and common suffix `end` independently and then does value.substring(start, value.length()-end). When sanitized is longer than value and they share prefix and suffix, start+end can exceed the string length, e.g. value="aaa" sanitized="aaaa" gives start=3 end=3 and substring(3,0). That throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException and aborts the whole verification instead of reporting illegal HTML. The end calculation must be bounded by length-start.

findings.title: Missing English bundle throws RuntimeException instead of MojoExecutionException
findings.body: verifySafeHtml opens the English source file with FileInputStream and on IOException throws new RuntimeException. A missing or unreadable English file therefore crashes the mojo with an unchecked exception and stack trace instead of a proper MojoExecutionException message. This is reachable for any new locale or mis-derived englishFile path and hides which file failed.

findings.title: Dropped anchor tags in translation are silently accepted
findings.body: santizeAnchors only iterates over anchors found in the translated value and compares them to the English anchors in order. If the translation deletes a required ... link, matcher.find() is false on entry, the loop never executes, no message is added, and verification passes. The result is a translation that loses a functional link/email action with no verifier warning, while added/changed anchors are flagged.

findings.title: English file derivation uses over-matching replaceAll
findings.body: String englishFile is built with replaceAll("resources-community","resources") and replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties","_en.properties"). replaceAll replaces every occurrence, not just the suffix, and the class [a-zA-Z-_] contains the range Z-_ which also matches [, \, ], ^. A path containing underscores elsewhere or those characters can be rewritten to the wrong file, causing false positives, false negatives, or the RuntimeException above when the derived file does not exist.

findings.title: Lithuanian bundle contains Italian text
findings.body: totpStep1 was changed to "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:" which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see Italian text in the account console. The same Italian string was also put in the login Lithuanian bundle, indicating a copy-paste error in this bulk fix.

findings.title: Lithuanian login bundle contains Italian text
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 was changed to "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:" which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian login pages will render Italian text. This appears to be a wrong-language substitution made to satisfy the new HTML verifier.
